mentions.heading: Liability arising out of certain governmental investigations and proceedings
mentions.detail: Cooperating with government investigations (Note 13); possible SEC or DOJ legal action and response costs
mentions.quote: However, we cannot predict the outcome or impact of any such ongoing matters, and there exists the possibility that we could be subject to liability, penalties and other restrictive sanctions and adverse consequences if the SEC, the U.S. Department of Justice or any other government agency were to pursue legal action in the future.

mentions.heading: Regulatory challenges to or limitations on our ability to sell vehicles directly
mentions.detail: State franchise laws and dealer associations challenge direct-to-consumer stores and dealer licenses; some states cap licenses or stores
mentions.quote: A few states have passed legislation that clarifies our ability to operate, but at the same time limits the number of dealer licenses we can obtain or stores that we can operate.

mentions.heading: The trading price of our common stock is likely to continue to be volatile
mentions.detail: 52-week range $214.25-$498.83; heavy short selling; past securities class actions
mentions.quote: Our common stock has experienced over the last 52 weeks an intra-day trading high of $498.83 per share and a low of $214.25 per share.

mentions.heading: Financial results may vary significantly from period to period
mentions.detail: Costs fluctuate with nonlinear pace of new product development and manufacturing capacity expansion
mentions.quote: We expect our period-to-period financial results to vary based on our operating costs, which we anticipate will fluctuate as the pace at which we continue to design, develop and manufacture new products and increase production capacity by expanding our current manufacturing facilities and adding future facilities, may not be consistent or linear between periods.
